title: Bounded Git status decomposition
failure_signature: A combined status, head, branch, and recursive directory probe exceeded its short wrapper timeout before producing output.
trigger_preconditions: A large Windows worktree is queried with several Git and recursive filesystem operations in one wrapper.
The wrapper timeout is shorter than the combined cold-path latency.
candidate_workaround: Split the probe into narrow Git commands and count staged and unstaged paths without recursive directory enumeration.
recurrence_guard: Use one bounded purpose per status probe and never treat a timeout as clean-state evidence.
rollback: Retain the timeout as an operational negative and make no state claim from it.
scope_boundary: Read-only owner-lane state inspection only; no repository mutation.
